amendmentScope: Only the five v2 files above are amended or created. No other protocol, receipt, raw record, or source file is changed by this amendment.

directionStatements.v1DevelopmentRan: LV01 v1 development ran and is retained, including development-v2 through development-v23 directories, detector development versions, fault and lifecycle fixtures, and resource-allocation records v1 through v23.
directionStatements.behavioralCohortDidNot: The v1 behavioral cohort did not run: no retained v1 pilot, full calibration, main, or repeat cohort exists. Development evidence must not be relabeled as pilot, main, or repeat evidence.
directionStatements.prospectiveRedesign: LV01 v2 is a deliberate prospective redesign on the Prototype runtime with an incremental-prediction primary family, not permission to run an old v1 packet with fewer checks.
directionStatements.dataPreviouslySeen: Data previously seen during development comprises sealed recurrent development records (including v16/v23 and other source-compatible sealed data) used only for the retrospective development diagnosis, which cannot supply pilot variance, confirmatory findings, prior prediction commitments, or design alternatives. The v15 tabular-path records are excluded from any recurrent estimate. No design threshold is tuned from development outcomes.
directionStatements.iterationHistoryKept: The five-iteration lifetime history is kept as-is, including the v23 iteration-1 declaration; no retrospective exemption renames inconvenient attempts.

claimLimits.prototype: Prototype results establish logical separation under a trusted process and operator for cooperative learners only. They cannot inherit hostile-process, timing-channel, or deployment-isolation claims.
claimLimits.modeRSeparate: Mode R qualifications, including the retained E00/E01/E02 evidence and the original nineteen-card confirmatory family, remain separate bounded evidence for their actual limited observations. Old receipts keep their old semantics.
claimLimits.interpretiveCorrections: Any new interpretive correction is a separate source-linked record that narrows a stronger summary; originals are never edited.

nineteenCardFamily.boundary: LV01 v2 does not rewrite, extend, or claim membership in the original portfolio.

claimBoundary: This draft amendment registers intent only. It is not a registration, allocation, qualification, result, review, or publication, and it authorizes no run.
